no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Per FY2025 10-K, Editas discontinued the ex vivo reni-cel (EDIT-301) program in 2024 and is winding down clinical/manufacturing activities. The company explicitly states 'All of our ongoing research programs are still in the preclinical or research stage of development.' Lead in vivo candidate EDIT-401 (LDLR upregulation for hyperlipidemia) is preclinical with IND planned mid-2026.
